login.title: Staff sign in
login.inviteHint: Have an invite link but ended up here?

mfa.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

enrol.intro: First sign-in: scan this with your authenticator app, then enter a code to finish.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code — scan with your authenticator app
enrol.manualEntry: Can't scan? Enter the code manually

recovery.intro: Save these one-time recovery codes somewhere safe — each works once if you lose your authenticator.
recovery.warning: They will not be shown again.

accept.title: Accept your staff invite
accept.intro: Set a password for your new staff account.

invite.title: Invite staff
invite.intro: Send an invite to add a new Super Admin, Admin or Service Admin. The link is valid for 7 days.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.validation: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
errors.mfaInvalid: That code isn't right. Try again.
errors.mfaAlreadyEnrolled: An authenticator is already set up for this account.
errors.accountLocked: This account isn't available. Contact another Super Admin.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a bit and try again.
errors.inviteInvalid: This invite link is invalid or has already been used.
errors.inviteEmailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
